note: Additions for My Learning Year on top of content/mathematics/curriculum.v1.json, which is unchanged. Micro-skills refine an existing competency (partOf); their evidence also counts for that parent competency in the shared ledger. 'supports' edges are teaching-navigation links used for prerequisite recovery; they are not the v1 inference prerequisites and do not change any estimate. Original, AI-assisted, not educator-reviewed. 1.1.0 adds micro-skills, supports, and two relation kinds that are never followed by recovery: 'alternatives' (another way to do the same work) and 'enrichment' (going further). Nothing in 1.0.0 is changed or removed.

competencies.name: Multiplication facts for 3 and 4
objectives: Recall or quickly derive products with 3 and 4

competencies.name: Multiplication facts for 6, 7, 8 and 9
objectives: Recall or derive products such as 7 × 8

competencies.name: Derive an unknown fact from known facts
objectives: Split a factor, double, or adjust a near fact to find a product

competencies.name: Equal parts of the same whole
objectives: See that 1/2 and 2/4 of the same strip cover the same length

competencies.name: Multiply numerator and denominator by the same number
objectives: Make an equivalent fraction by scaling both parts

competencies.name: Decide whether two fractions are equal
objectives: Compare by a common denominator or by scaling

competencies.name: Area under a constant function is a rectangle
objectives: Read the integral of a constant as width × height

competencies.name: Powers of whole numbers
objectives: Work out a power such as 2⁵ as repeated multiplication

competencies.name: The distributive property: a(x + b)
objectives: Multiply every term inside a bracket by the number outside

competencies.name: Expand (x + a)(x + b)
objectives: Multiply two brackets term by term and collect the x terms

competencies.name: Differentiate a power of x
objectives: Use d/dx (k xⁿ) = k n xⁿ⁻¹ and evaluate it at a point

competencies.name: Antiderivative of a power of x
objectives: Use ∫ k xⁿ dx = k xⁿ⁺¹ ⁄ (n + 1) + C and evaluate it between limits

competencies.name: Integrate by substitution
objectives: Choose u, rewrite the integral in u, and change the limits

competencies.name: Integrate by parts
objectives: Use ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du

supports.note: An area integral of a constant is a rectangle: width × height, read from the graph. (Definite integrals are already its mandatory prerequisite; not repeated here.)
Adding like fractions counts equal parts.
A fraction times a whole number is repeated addition of like fractions.
A whole-number power is repeated multiplication.
Expanding a(x + b) multiplies a by each term.
(x + a)(x + b) is two distributive steps; the x terms are collected with signed numbers.
The power rule lowers the power by one and multiplies by it.
An antiderivative undoes a derivative; evaluating it needs powers and fractions with the same denominator.
A substitution evaluates u = x² + c at the limits.
b² − 4ac is signed arithmetic with a square.

alternatives.note: An area model: (x + a)(x + b) is a rectangle x + a by x + b, cut into four parts.
Read the solutions where the graph of y = x² + px + q crosses the x-axis.

enrichment.note: When there are no real solutions, the complex ones.
Separable differential equations use the same integrals.
